coverage.fileprovider_materialization_scope: Residency-only exact-file downloads; every complete byte stream is hash-checked and its logical size/mtime must remain unchanged.

fileprovider_materialization_audit.interpretation: FileProvider materialization changes local residency only. The analyzer does not write source artifacts, and verifies complete bytes, SHA-256, logical size and logical mtime before using them.

final_fingerprint_and_strict_replay_bind.contract: Each final input fingerprint is recomputed from frozen candidate, exact judge configuration, prompt and ordered image SHA list; the final strict-valid raw response is replayed through the frozen validator and must exactly match the stored parsed criteria and score.

interpretation.candidate_and_images: Candidate answers are text. Multimodal requirements come from official question and solution/marking PNGs, passed directly to the four vision judges; text-staticized judges receive zero image blocks.
interpretation.contest_uncertainty: Each repeat is aggregated independently; mean and sample SD are computed over the three contest totals (IPhO /30, IChO /60).
interpretation.text_only: Rows involving Qwen or DeepSeek are text-staticized modality-sensitivity results, not evidence against the full-fidelity vision pipeline.
interpretation.validity: Repeat and pairwise agreement measure reliability/concordance, not validity. Validity requires the separate human-calibration evidence.
interpretation.vision_primary: Only vision-vs-vision rows are primary full-fidelity judge agreement results.

protocol_recovery.deepseek: The complete 273-cell DeepSeek route uses thinking enabled with max_tokens=65536. The complete old 16384-token route is excluded from all scores because six long-item cells exhausted reasoning with empty visible content.
protocol_recovery.gemini31: One cell uses a separate same-model, same-payload/options post-exhaustion strict recovery ledger (two additional calls); the original failure and seven attempts remain immutable.
protocol_recovery.mixed_cell_policy: No old DeepSeek score is mixed into the effective route.

scope.limitation: One frozen solver route only: no 14-model ranking correlation and no cross-candidate robustness inference.

gemini31_recovery_payload_binding.payload_delta_policy: Attempt 1 uses the frozen base prompt; attempt 2 preserves the same candidate, rubric, images, route and options and appends only the deterministic strict-validator retry instruction derived from attempt 1.

retrospective_pipeline_provenance_addend.evidentiary_scope: The current pipeline.py hash identifies only the code imported by this post-hoc strict replay. The original sealed run provenance did not contemporaneously pin pipeline.py; neither the current file nor the historical expected hash is represented as the source that generated the old runs. Filesystem mtime is reported descriptively and is not used to backdate or authenticate run-generation code.
